title: Legion of Super-Heroes #287 + Legionnaires 3 #4 Lot DC 1982 1986 Giffen Kharlak
condition_description: Both covers clean with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light toning on the backs and the Legionnaires 3 cream cover. See photos.
description:
Two Legion of Super-Heroes comics from DC:

- The Legion of Super-Heroes #287 (May 1982) - "vs. Kharlak - Odds Against Survival: 17 to 1", Keith Giffen and Larry Mahlstedt cover. 60c. Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger "Free Western Town" toy ad.
- Legionnaires 3 #4 of 4 (May 1986) - final issue, "Okay, Time Trapper -- You Win!" Cosmic Boy cover. Plot by Keith Giffen, script by Mindy Newell, pencils by Ernie Colon, cover by Ernie Colon and Karl Kesel. 75c. Back cover: Monogram Lightning RC racer ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
